prompt: here is my clay-table.json with columns first_name and verified_email. Write a sequence that personalizes on their recent funding round.

assertions.name: detects-missing-column

assertions.name: does-not-ship-broken-tag

assertions.name: proposes-column
assertions.check: Proposes adding the producing column to the Clay table
